shared_constraints: One detached component, genuine transparent background, front three-quarter side view, studio light upper-left, no text/labels/borders/extra parts. Head sprites include an empty socket; hafts include a centered top tenon. Preserve the distinct material identity and grounded realistic fantasy inventory-art treatment.
